notes.title: Full Release
notes.notes:
Hi, dear players.
The release of the game Dofamine took place. During Early Access, we fixed a number of bugs and added localizations. We hope you enjoy it. Thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38922154/aaef3ab1fbdef2fb6d556ed4d0104d43c79b6037.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Global Language Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We are pleased to present you with a global language update.
The following languages are now available in the game: English, Italian, Spanish, Chinese (traditional), Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, French, German, Chinese (simplified), Dutch, Polish, Czech, Japanese.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38922154/86c2b0fdadb1ecca34b02cfec7f7763cdb7c696a.png[/img]

notes.title: Some words about the project
notes.notes:
Dopamine is a puzzle of a new format, where you have to go through a maze of riddles to understand what a "particle of God" or the Higgs boson is.
